column1: # The read-only smoke check of the API (#794): smoke.sh sends each line, a GET, and compares the status.
# Columns, tab-separated: group, method, path, expected statuses, auth.
#   group     the API service the route manifest (Helm/avalon-api/files/routes.json) sends the path to;
#             AVALON_SMOKE_GROUPS picks groups. Every rule of the manifest has a line (SmokeCoverageShould).
#   path      as the API sees it, query string included, appended to BASE.
#   expected  comma-separated statuses, or classes such as 2xx. A 405 on a POST-only route, or a 403 that
#             only identity gives, shows the request reached the service that maps the route; any other
#   auth      none, or pat: sent with AVALON_SMOKE_PAT, an Admin personal access token.
# Production serves no API docs (#803): the OpenAPI document and Scalar are not mapped.
